title: nan
authors: Yue Z.; Zhang M.; Ma W.; Ding W.; Li K.; Tang C.
key_contribution: Presents an adaptive state-constrained vehicle navigation system using fuzzy inference over upward fisheye optical flow, IMU, and dual odometry for dynamic ZUPT and NHC constraint selection.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
